Extract the durable facts from the text below, each with the reason it is true, and store them with the store_memory tool. Give each fact an origin ("user" for what the user stated, "agent" for what you concluded, "external" with a sourceTag for what a source such as slack or jira states) and a scope ("company", "project" or "personal"). If store_memory returns questions, ask the user those questions, then call it again with the revised items and the answers as clarifications. Report what was stored.

We use pnpm, not npm.
CI runs on Linux.
